name: mapgen_age

name: cityview_wnd

name: mp_meeting_pending

name: scenario_events_loaded

name: game_loop_active

name: turn_resume_civ

name: unit_blink_active
evidence: Set while the active unit awaits orders; cleared to suppress blinking during redraws, gates the cursor-blink timer (004131c0).

name: unit_blink_phase

name: game_language

name: dir_dx_table

name: dir_dy_table

name: city_tile_dx_table

name: city_tile_dy_table

name: panel_margin_y
